name: medha-workspace
description: medha: evidential-memory engine as a library. Four packages (core, store, sync, medha) with enforced boundaries. Self-contained so the whole directory can be extracted to its own repo.

scripts.boundaries: depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs medha-core/src medha-store/src medha-sync/src medha/src cli/src
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run boundaries && bun run test
